name: Motorcycle
description: A passenger vehicle on two or three wheels (motocyclette), other than a power-assisted bicycle, that differs from a moped in at least one way, such as a top speed over 70 km/h; a road-registered electric motorcycle is one, while one built for off-highway use is an off-highway vehicle instead.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels, and at least one characteristic a moped can't have, such as a top speed over 70 km/h or a manual transmission
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 4

restrictions.rule: A road vehicle: must be registered with the SAAQ, paying the public automobile insurance contribution with the registration
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 6, 21

restrictions.rule: Riders need a motorcycle licence, from age 16, after the SAAQ's training course; class 6A covers any motorcycle, while 6B and 6C are limited by engine displacement
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 67; Regulation respecting licences, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 34, ss. 7.12.1, 28.8–28.10

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a motorcycle helmet, and the rider needs eye protection without a visor where the limit is over 50 km/h
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 484; Protective Helmets Regulation, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 6, s. 2

restrictions.rule: The headlight must be on at all times, and it needs a mirror on each side
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 263, 482

restrictions.rule: Carries a passenger only on a fixed seat with footrests on each side
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 480

restrictions.rule: One with an electric motor rated 11 kW or less isn't allowed on limited-access highways or their entrance and exit ramps
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 479

restrictions.rule: Can't ride between lanes of moving traffic or between a vehicle and the edge of the road
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 478

restrictions.rule: One that looks like a motorcycle but lacks a federal compliance label or a US or Mexican safety certification mark is banned from public highways if it has footrests or a platform, motorcycle-style wheels and tires, a body covering its frame with no height-adjustable saddle, or a motor able to exceed 32 km/h or 500 W
restrictions.citation: Ministerial Order 2024-24, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 0.1.3, ss. 1, 2
